intro: The ten most-played Roblox games this week. Murder Mystery 2 had a wild weekend.
method: Ranked by player counts on the public tracker Endgametools (snapshot Oct 26, 2026, 10:08 UTC), cross-checked with Livecounts. Counts swing a lot: Murder Mystery 2 was briefly No. 1 on Oct 25 and back at No. 4 a day later.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Back on top after Murder Mystery 2 briefly passed it on Oct 25.

entries.name: Brookhaven RP
entries.note: Steady at about 300,000 players on Oct 26.

entries.name: Steal a Brainrot
entries.note: Up two spots, with about 277,000 players on Oct 26.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: Hit a record of about 2.2 million players at once on Oct 25 (Livecounts).

entries.name: 99 Nights in the Forest
entries.note: Up three, with about 205,000 players on Oct 26.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: The final week of Halloween brings back the Where Bear? minigame.

entries.name: RIVALS
entries.note: RIVALSWEEN runs until Nov 6; unspent Candy is deleted after.

entries.name: Break and Steal an Egg
entries.note: One of only two top-25 games growing in Livecounts' 24-hour change.

entries.name: Blox Fruits
entries.note: Holding steady at about 145,000 players on Oct 26.

entries.name: Jujutsu Shenanigans
entries.note: Down three spots, about 95,000 players on Oct 26.
